summary: A request too vague to build. Scenario E12 submits it.

revisions.title: Make the output better
body: The output of the word count tool is confusing. Please improve it.

behavior: The factory classifies the request as ambiguous at intake.
It asks exactly one focused question on the issue, in plain English, and waits for the answer. The job is WAITING_FOR_HUMAN at the intake stage.
No later stage starts, no sandbox is created and no model is asked to build anything until the answer arrives.
The question is recorded in the audit trail with the time and the correlation id.
